messages:
Liam: Heads-up I'm opening a small docs PR to tighten SOC2 wording in the audit export and migration guide. Draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4932 - mainly retention language and export flags.
Anya: Can you paste the short top blurb you'll use so I can quick-review for product folks?
Liam: Draft blurb:
"Audit exports contain event-level telemetry used for tenant audits and troubleshooting. By default, personal identifiers (for example, email addresses) are pseudonymized in exported artifacts. Tenants may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized and are recorded in the tenant audit trail. Retention: default 365 days; records under legal hold are retained until released. Exports are encrypted in transit and at rest."
Priya: Legal: swap "may request" -> "may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized and are recorded." Also prefer "personal identifiers" and avoid "anonymous."
Marco: Security: add a parenthetical about mapping exports: "(mapping exports available only to tenant admins and require explicit consent)". Also mention "pseudonymization is not a replacement for access controls."
Liam: Will update. Also adding migration helpers: sed to update scripts from old flag `redact_personal` to `pseudonymize`:
```bash
# update nginx/automation scripts
sed -i 's/redact_personal/pseudonymize/g' $(git ls-files '*.sh' '*.py' '*.js')
```
Anya: Nice. Add a tiny CI test suggestion to assert no email in output when pseudonymize=true: `assert not re.search(r"[\\w.+-]+@[\\w.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}", output)`
ops-bot: docs-ci: lint OK, staging preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/audit-export (expires in 48h)
Liam: Fixed anchor link for the export-playbook and added cross-links to Data Retention Policy. Pushed final changes and requested legal/security sign-off. Thanks all.
